title: 第十九章魔血沸腾李长寿的高光第二十章炼虚大能降临叶夕瑶的背景
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 血云子起初看到这把剑也被吓了一跳，但看到李长寿的修为时，整个人都变得贪婪起来。
“小辈，这份机缘不属于你，留下吧！”
“给我镇压！”
万魂血印镇压而下，周围的虚空都开始泛起一丝丝涟漪，足以这一击的恐怖。
可李长寿面不改色，反而露出了蔑视的冷笑，他在心中默念：“魔血沸腾，统子给我燃烧五十年的寿元！”
这一声落下，宛如九天惊雷，天穹上的黑云变成血色，血祭结界所凝聚的气血被强行冲散。
李长寿体内的经脉在这一刻开始扩张，气息开始暴涨，足足五十倍力量的提升！
金丹后期！
元婴初期！
元婴中期！
这股威压落下，整片天地无不为之色变，城中的邪修无法抵抗，脑海中竟有一种想要匍匐跪拜的冲动。
主要是这股气息太邪门了，完全就是魔气，比他们还要邪修，甚至比宗门的护法还要恐怖强横。
感受着体内澎湃的力量，李长寿只是轻轻挥了挥手，覆盖全城的血祭大阵当场崩溃，化作道道红光。
噗噗噗！
城中的邪修跪倒一片，被这股惊人的威慑力吓了一大跳。
结界崩碎，他们的血气加成也随之消失，全都气息大减。
“你...你也是邪修？！”血云子只觉得相当窒息，说话断断续续，仿佛周围的灵气被抽空，令得他呼吸困难。
‘这就是老爷子的实力吗？邪修不都是十恶不赦，为什么会选择救我？’
‘我懂了，邪修定然也分善恶，就像是家里的妖兽大黄一样。’叶夕瑶距离李长寿最近，难免不会乱想。
“这里太危险，先送你去安全的地方，否则老朽施展不开。”
李长寿并不知道叶夕瑶的猜想，在她口中塞了几颗低配疗伤丹，将她转移到安全的地点。
随后目光阴冷的看向血云子。
“本座本在城中清修，奈何你们执意找死，只能送你们一程。”
“不...不是的，我们这就走！”
血云子展露出一副害怕的样子，企图获得对方的原谅。
只可惜李长寿根本就没有理会，直接就是一个魔灵化鼎。
“他奶奶的，真当老夫怕你不成。”
“既然你不给我活路，那你也别想活着。”
“血海，给我来！”
血云子双手掐诀，先前在城中吸收的血气，以及各个角落的血井鲜血全都涌入他的身体。
在这股气血的加持下，他的气息仅仅只是比李长寿弱上一筹。
当然，这只是他用低等秘法强行提升上来的，只能爆发出一击的全盛时期之力。
李长寿的秘法‘魔血沸腾’可以维持一刻钟的时间，完全就是一个天上一个地下。
“万魂血印，给我镇压！”
大印随即甩出，蕴含着浓浓的血气，可谓是压盖天地。
血云子所能爆发最强的一击，只要能够挡住李长寿的攻击片刻，他就可以使用血遁术逃离此地。
很快大鼎和血印在虚空碰撞在一起，发出一声毁灭性的爆鸣声。
万魂血印发出咔咔咔的响声，上面的基石开始溃烂，一缕缕血气化作青烟，消散在天地。
当然，李长寿所凝聚的魔灵化鼎消失的更加迅速。
他这毕竟是玄阶下品神通所凝聚的杀招，远没有吸收三千万生灵万魂血印坚固。
血云子抓住这个空档，身躯变得虚幻最终化为五道洪流血光，朝着黑风城不同的方向逃去。
那逃跑速度，丝毫不比正常的元婴强者差。
content_en:
Xueyunzi was shocked at first when he saw the sword, but when he saw Li Changshou's cultivation, he became greedy.
"Junior, this opportunity does not belong to you, keep it!"
"Suppress me!"
The Ten Thousand Souls Blood Seal was suppressed, and ripples began to appear in the surrounding void, which was enough to be terrifying from this attack.
But Li Changshou didn't change his expression, but showed a contemptuous sneer. He silently recited in his heart: "The devil's blood is boiling, Tongzi will burn fifty years of life for me!"
This sound fell like thunder from the sky, and the black clouds in the sky turned into blood, and the energy and blood condensed in the blood sacrifice barrier were forcibly dispersed.
The meridians in Li Changshou's body began to expand at this moment, his aura began to surge, and his strength increased by a full fifty times!
Late stage of Golden Elixir!
...
The early stage of Nascent Soul!
...
The middle stage of Nascent Soul!
When this coercion fell, the entire world changed color. The evil cultivators in the city could not resist, and there was an urge in their minds to kneel down and worship.
The main reason is that this aura is too evil, it is completely demonic, more evil than them, and even more terrifying and tyrannical than the sect's protector.
Feeling the surging power in his body, Li Changshou just waved his hand gently, and the blood sacrifice formation covering the whole city collapsed on the spot and turned into red light.
Puff puff puff!
The evil cultivators in the city fell to their knees, frightened by this astonishing intimidation.
The barrier collapsed, their health bonus also disappeared, and their aura was greatly reduced.
"You...you are also an evil cultivator?!" Xueyunzi felt quite suffocated and spoke intermittently, as if the spiritual energy around him had been drained, making it difficult for him to breathe.
‘Is this the old man’s strength? If evil cultivators are not all heinous, why would they choose to save me? ’
‘I understand, evil cultivators must also be divided into good and evil, just like the monster rhubarb at home. ’ Ye Xiyao is the closest to Li Changshou, so it’s inevitable that she won’t have random thoughts.
"It's too dangerous here. I'll send you to a safe place first, otherwise I won't be able to use it."
Li Changshou didn't know Ye Xiyao's suspicion, so he stuffed a few low-quality healing pills into her mouth and moved her to a safe place.
Then he looked at Xueyunzi with cold eyes.
"I was originally in the city to clean up my body, but you insist on seeking death, so I can only give you a ride."
"No...no, let's leave now!"
Xueyunzi showed a fearful look, trying to gain forgiveness from the other party.
It's a pity that Li Changshou didn't pay attention at all and just turned into a demon spirit cauldron.
"His grandma, I'm really afraid of you."
"Since you don't give me a way to live, then you don't want to live either."
"Sea of blood, come here!"
Xueyunzi made a hand seal, and the blood energy he had absorbed in the city before, as well as the blood from the blood wells in every corner, all poured into his body.
With the blessing of this energy and blood, his aura was only slightly weaker than Li Changshou.
Of course, this was just something he forcibly improved using low-level secret techniques, and he could only unleash the power of his heyday in one blow.
Li Changshou's secret technique 'Demon Blood Boiling' can last for a quarter of an hour, which is completely equivalent to the sky and the earth.
"The Blood Seal of Ten Thousand Souls, suppress it!"
The big seal was thrown out immediately, containing so much blood that it could be said to cover the world.
Xueyunzi can unleash the strongest blow. As long as he can block Li Changshou's attack for a moment, he can use blood escape to escape from here.
Soon the cauldron and the blood seal collided in the void, making a devastating explosion.
The Ten Thousand Souls Blood Seal made a clicking sound, and the foundation stone above began to fester, and wisps of blood turned into blue smoke and dissipated in the heaven and earth.
Of course, the demon spirit cauldron condensed by Li Changshou disappeared even faster.
After all, his killing move was condensed with low-grade magical powers at the Xuan level, and it was far from being as strong as absorbing the blood seal of 30 million living beings and souls.
Xueyunzi seized this opportunity, and his body became illusory and finally turned into five torrents of blood, and fled in different directions of Black Wind City.
That escape speed is no worse than a normal Nascent Soul strongman.
